admission.justification: Removing the agents alone still lets a closing lie about an owed target or let a prepared start publish a live execution past the boundary; the rules together promise an outcome none promises alone.

guarantee: A closed leaf archives exactly its own recorded role agents before the worktrees are removed, whether idle or in a turn, and reports the truth about every archived, already-archived, gone, owed and left-alone target. A prepared start whose agent is not yet created is refused once its leaf's closing mark is present and its settlement says so; a start whose creation is already entered is not waited for — its minted target stays receipt-owned debt until the returned agent is archived and the start refused, without erasing the retirement record. The family does not promise an instantaneous no-live state while an entered creation's archival is still owed.
title: A closed leaf archives its recorded role agents and publishes no prepared start as running past the closing mark; an entered creation is archived on return
